description: This file defines a client class for interacting with the Amazon Interactive Video Service Chat (ivschat) via AWS SDK for PHP. It specifies methods for managing chat tokens, rooms, logging configurations, and related resources, including synchronous and asynchronous variants.

classes.name: ivschatClient
classes.description: Client class for AWS ivschat service, extending the base AwsClient, providing methods to interact with Amazon Interactive Video Service Chat.

methods.name: createChatToken
methods.description: Creates a chat token for a user in the IVS chat service.

methods.name: createChatTokenAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a chat token for a user.

methods.name: createLoggingConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a logging configuration for the chat service.

methods.name: createRoomAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new chat room.

methods.name: deleteMessage
methods.description: Deletes a specified message from a chat room.

methods.name: disconnectUser
methods.description: Disconnects a user from a chat room.

methods.name: getRoom
methods.description: Gets details of a specified chat room.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: sendEvent
methods.description: Sends an event to a chat room.
